name: RetentionReleaseTracker
tagline: Every retention account – payable and receivable – from valuation to final release, in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete construction retention module for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: retention held per contract with rates, limits and retention bonds; first-moiety releases at practical completion and balances after the defects liability period with payment-terms due dates; open defects and holds that block releases; bond cover checks; a release schedule, a release board with status rules and a monthly retention cash forecast. Works instantly with fictional demo data and connects to your own table in a few clicks.
features: Payable (subcontract) and receivable (client) retention in one ledger
Retention % and limit % of contract sum, per account or by default
First moiety at practical completion, balance after the defects period
Payment-terms due dates with overdue flags
Open defects and holds block the final release
Bond / guarantee cover checked against the final release date
Release schedule with due and overdue markers
Monthly retention cash forecast in vs out
Release notice text for e-mail / Teams (OnAction)
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
